en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a historic spa town nestled in a forested valley, showing dense 19th‑century buildings along a narrow river and rising up wooded hillsides. A large grand hotel-type complex with corner towers stands high on the slope in the distance. In the foreground are elegant multi‑storey townhouses and a prominent white neoclassical building. The caption at the bottom left reads "Weltbad Karlsbad."
